chat.body: Why does PokemonFilters call storeToRefs instead of reading filters.type?

`storeToRefs(filters)` returns `type` and `trainerId` as refs that stay linked to the store, so the `v-model` of each select writes straight into it. Destructuring `filters` without it copies the values once, and the selects would stop updating the store.
